description: Per-chapter cast shortlists generated from the Frieren wiki dataset (Characters in Order of Appearance) intersected with the reference roster in data/refs/. Selected deterministically by --cast-key ('cNNN'); never fetched remotely during a run. Only characters with a reference image are listed (the detector must report everything else as unknown, never guess); mentioned-only characters are excluded too. Generated by build_chapter_casts.py; do not edit by hand, regenerate instead.
